info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Business Risk Models Management API
info.description: This API enables organizations to update and refine their business risk models to ensure they stay relevant and effective in mitigating risks. With the PATCH method, consumers can modify specific attributes of existing risk models, allowing for continuous improvement and adaptation to changing business environments. Typical users include risk managers, compliance officers, and data analysts who are involved in risk assessment and management. By utilizing this API, businesses can enhance their risk management strategies and align their operations with regulatory requirements.

patch.summary: Update a specific business risk model.
patch.description: This endpoint allows users to update the properties of a particular business risk model identified by its unique ID. It is essential for managing and maintaining accurate risk assessments.
